usage.title: How to use
usage.description: Complete the setup once. After that, capture a screen and run the Shortcut to create a reviewable draft.

find.title: 1. Get the Shortcut
find.description: Start installing “鲸浪记账 截屏自动记账” from its iCloud page.
find.imageAlt: Screenshots showing how to get the Whale Wave screenshot bookkeeping Shortcut
captions: On the iCloud Shortcut page, confirm the name and tap “Get Shortcut”.
On the Shortcut details page, tap “Set Up Shortcut” to begin.

configure.title: 2. Configure and add the Shortcut
configure.description: Enter the connection key from this page, then finish adding the Shortcut.
configure.imageAlt: Screenshots showing how to paste the connection key in Shortcuts
captions: Tap the token field and paste the connection key copied from this page.
Confirm the key is filled in, then tap “Add Shortcut”.
After it is added, return here to set up a quick way to run it.

backTap.title: 3. Set up Back Tap (optional)
backTap.description: Follow the settings path and bind the Shortcut to a double-tap on your iPhone.
backTap.imageAlt: Screenshots showing how to configure Back Tap on iPhone
captions: Select “鲸浪记账 截屏自动记账” to finish.

confirm.title: Running it opens a web confirmation
confirm.description: Capture a screen containing the expense, then run “鲸浪记账 截屏自动记账”. The Shortcut uses OCR to create a draft and opens a web confirmation page; the record is saved only after you review it.

faq.title: What if the result is wrong?
faq.description: Shortcut Bookkeeping is still being adapted and improved for payment pages. Your reports help us make it better.

recognition.question: Why can the category or amount be wrong?
recognition.answer: The Shortcut uses OCR on the payment page in your screenshot. We are still adding support for more payment pages, whose layouts, fonts, and labels can differ. This can occasionally cause the category or amount to be misread.

feedback.question: What should I do when I find an error?
feedback.answer: Review and correct the draft on the web confirmation page first, then use the feedback channel to share the payment page, the detected category or amount, and the correct result. More context helps us investigate.

improve.question: How does feedback help?
improve.answer: We use real payment pages to improve our adaptation rules and gradually make amount and category recognition more accurate. Thanks for helping build a better Shortcut Bookkeeping experience.
